summary: A mother gives her teenager an album of a dead president's speeches and he listens alone.
realLife: An Obama speechwriter said his parents were not very political at home, though his mother, a Democrat, gave him an album of Kennedy speeches as a teen. He listened to them while other kids played outside and heard the rhythm of the words. He saw the Kennedys as local news on Cape Cod.
gates: A parent has a leaning and a teenager lives at home.
inGame: Household members and a record of speeches a person heard could carry it.

turns.what: The teen finds it dull and puts it away.
The teen plays it once and the mother never asks.
turns.writesBack: Adds the speech to what he heard.

turns.what: Years later the teen works on speeches.
turns.writesBack: Adds the mother as an influence.
